summary: Verified Commercials Manager bug fixes for the Hush Music TV Network. Backend assign/register endpoints correctly drop stale channel_ids while preserving valid ones, return 200 across all scenarios. Frontend Edit modal Save Changes shows success toast 'Channel assignment updated!' (no error toast). Upload UI works correctly. All 6 backend tests pass, all UI flows pass.
action_items: MINOR (pre-existing, out of scope): /commercials direct navigation (page.goto or hard refresh) redirects to '/' because Commercials.jsx useEffect runs `if (!user?.is_admin) navigate('/')` while user is still null during AuthContext hydration. In-app navigation via /dashboard works fine. Suggestion: gate the redirect on a loading=false state, or check localStorage user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5186 lines - should be split into modules (commercials.py, channels.py, auth.py routers) for maintainability.
Commercials.jsx useEffect redirect logic does not wait for AuthContext hydration; deep-link reload to /commercials redirects to home even for admins.
assign_commercial_to_channels and register_commercial duplicate the stale-channel filtering logic - could be extracted into a helper `filter_valid_channel_ids(channel_ids)`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (upload UI + edit save no-mod + All Channels save)

seed_data_creation: None - tested against existing 29 commercials and 57 channels in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_commercials_assign.py covers: list commercials, PUT /assign with mixed stale+valid (200, stale dropped, valid kept), PUT /assign with only stale (becomes global), PUT /assign is_global=true clears channels, PUT /assign all valid preserves them, POST /register drops stale + persists valid with GET verify. Frontend Edit modal verified via dashboard navigation; deep-link goto causes auth-hydration redirect (preexisting non-blocker).
rca of the issue: Original bug: assign_commercial_to_channels (server.py:1734) and register_commercial (server.py:1443) validated every channel_id and threw 404 if ANY was stale. Many legacy commercials had stale channel_ids from deleted channels, blocking saves and uploads. Fix (already applied): query db.channels for the IDs in payload, keep only existing ones, log dropped IDs as warning, treat as global when no valid channels remain. Verified end-to-end via pytest + UI.
